purpose: Avoid additional GPU allocations after an earlier fixed window fails.
mechanism: Append the previous ArtifactStep to each later window dependency tuple using dataclasses.replace; use existing StepRunner dependency-failure propagation. No new runner or retry policy.
runtime_materialization_note: A handle materialized twice produces different attempt_id and launch_config_yaml fields because each materialization creates a new attempt identity. The check compares the canonical recipe payload, explicit execution settings and other stable materialized fields.
